design_notes: 第一階段以值得專程搭乘的日本船旅為核心；目前卡片總數由母資料即時計算，不屬於 schema 固定規格，也不代表最終全集。
後續可分階段加入非觀光性質航路，不以A/B/C/D作為程式固定邏輯。
分類、標籤、體驗性質與卡片基準彼此獨立；UI篩選器應由資料自動生成。

fields.card_basis: string; current values ship/route, future values allowed
fields.operation: string; current values year_round/seasonal/scheduled; future values allowed
fields.travel_tip: string; optional; practical trip-planning advice that changes how a traveler uses or plans the experience; empty string means not yet provided
fields.access_tip: string; optional; practical access/transfer advice that reduces walking, confusion, or transfer risk; empty string means not yet provided
fields.scenic_tip: string; optional; practical viewing/seat/timing advice for improving the onboard experience; empty string means not yet provided

reserved_policy.future_categories: 新增分類只需加入 categories 與卡片資料，不應修改 renderer 核心邏輯
reserved_policy.counts: 所有總數與分類數量由資料即時計算，不寫死
reserved_policy.migrations: 以 schema_version 管理資料遷移
reserved_policy.tips: travel_tip/access_tip/scenic_tip are independent optional content layers; renderer may hide empty values and should not infer missing tips
